title: The answer-key totals and daily averages cover December 2000 through December 2012, not the prompt's December 2000 through April 2012, so a correctly scoped answer will not match.
evidence: Volumes!E11:E147 (TCO) sums to about 48.17M and M11:M147 (CNG) to about 23.73M, for a combined nominal total of about 71.90M through Apr-2012. Adding May–Dec 2012 (rows 148–155, 8×(267,940.19+131,970.54) ≈ 3.20M) gives about 75.10M, which matches the key's 'Total Monthly Nominal Volume (CNG+TCO): 75,100,712'. TCO daily average through Apr-2012 is about 11,550, but through Dec-2012 it is about 11,400, consistent with the key's 11,409.
confirmation: Volumes!E11:E147+M11:M147 (Dec-2000 to Apr-2012) sums to 71,901,426, while E11:E155+M11:M155 (through Dec-2012) sums to 75,100,712, which is exactly the key's nominal total. The key's 11,409 daily average likewise matches the through-Dec-2012 mean (Apr-2012 gives about 11,564).
